mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts relative to the prior quarter signals weakening residential demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle periods with HOUST decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past three months indicates labor market strength, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining UNRATE, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales and rise in consumer price inflation indicates weakening demand amid cost pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% y/y), a federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation periods, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.
